theme_central: The Day of mutual dispossession (yawm at-taghabun): Allah, absolute Sovereign, addresses in turn all of mankind, then the disbelievers, then the believers.

branches.title: Address to all mankind
branches.resume: Everything glorifies Allah, absolute Sovereign; He knows the secret and the manifest.

children.t: Allah's absolute sovereignty, knowledge of the secret and the manifest

branches.title: Address to the disbelievers
branches.resume: Fate of the ancient peoples who denied; the Day of mutual dispossession, faith and disbelief rewarded.

children.t: Fate of the ancient peoples, the Day of mutual dispossession

branches.title: Address to the believers
branches.resume: Nothing happens without Allah's permission, caution toward spouses and children, a good loan to Allah multiplied.

children.t: Caution toward spouses and children, spending as a loan multiplied by Allah
